description: Deterministic benchmark dataset for Industrial Incident Investigator retrieval and RAG evaluation

test_cases.query: What caused the high vibration and babbitt wiping on steam turbine HP-17?
test_cases.reference_answer: The vibration and babbitt wiping on turbine HP-17 bearing B-101 was caused by seal degradation in oil cooler E-201 allowing cooling water and glycol to contaminate the lubrication circuit. This accelerated sludge accumulation and particulate blockage of orifice valve V-204, starving the bearing pad of oil and causing hydrodynamic lubrication collapse.
ground_truth_passages: Seal degradation in oil cooler E-201 allowed cooling water and glycol to contaminate the turbine lubrication circuit.
particulate blockage of orifice valve V-204. Starved of pressurized oil film, hydrodynamic lubrication collapsed, causing babbitt wiping

test_cases.query: Why did the emergency inhibitor quench pump QP-02 fail to start on reactor RX-404?
test_cases.reference_answer: Inhibitor quench pump QP-02 failed to energize because local physical bypass key switch SW-8 was inadvertently left in the MANUAL TEST position following annual turnaround proof-testing 10 days prior, which disabled the automated emergency chemical quench.
ground_truth_passages: The chemical inhibitor injection pump QP-02 did not start because local physical bypass key switch SW-8 was found in the 'MANUAL TEST' position.
Maintenance logs show switch SW-8 was positioned in manual during annual turnaround proof-testing 10 days prior and was never returned to 'AUTO ARMED'.

test_cases.query: What protection relay code tripped conveyor motor M-301 and what was the maximum recorded temperature?
test_cases.reference_answer: Conveyor motor M-301 tripped on protection code E-301 (Motor Thermal Overload), and the stator winding Embedded Temperature Detectors registered a maximum temperature of 148°C, approaching the Class F insulation limit of 155°C.
ground_truth_passages: tripped unexpectedly on protection code E-301 (Motor Thermal Overload).
Stator winding Embedded Temperature Detectors (ETD-1 through ETD-6) registered a maximum temperature of 148°C

test_cases.query: How did moisture freeze-up in air dryer D-10 lead to compressor K-102 surge shutdown?
test_cases.reference_answer: Desiccant air dryer D-10 experienced switching valve SV-4 failure, sending saturated unconditioned air into instrument lines. During an ambient temperature drop, water condensed and froze in pilot solenoid valve SOV-102, slamming suction bypass valve FV-102 shut, which starved compressor K-102 of mass flow and triggered aerodynamic surge.
ground_truth_passages: Failure of desiccant air dryer D-10 switching valve SV-4 allowed high dew-point air into outdoor instrument tubing, causing icing and pneumatic solenoid failure
Suction header bypass valve FV-102 slammed shut without modulation command from the DCS

test_cases.query: What caused false level readings on deaerator transmitter LT-501 leading to BFP-02 pump cavitation?
test_cases.reference_answer: Deaerator level transmitter LT-501 accumulated sediment in its condensing pot, causing the wet reference leg water column to partially boil away during a load swing. This produced a false 350 mm high reading offset (showing 68% when actual level was 18%), depleting deaerator inventory and dropping NPSHa to 2.1 m.
ground_truth_passages: condensing chamber pot had accumulated sediment, causing the reference leg water column to partially boil away during the load swing, creating a false 350 mm high reading offset.
Hydraulic cavitation due to available Net Positive Suction Head (NPSHa) falling to 2.1 meters, well below pump required NPSHr of 3.8 meters.

test_cases.query: Which valve actuator diaphragm ruptured causing thermal runaway in vessel RX-404?
test_cases.reference_answer: The pneumatic actuator diaphragm on chilled water modulating valve TCV-404 suffered a 40 mm longitudinal tear, jamming the valve stem at only 12% open position and starving reactor RX-404 of jacket cooling during the exothermic peak.
ground_truth_passages: Physical inspection of chilled water modulating valve TCV-404 showed the valve stem physically stuck at 12% stroke.
Disassembly of the pneumatic actuator showed a 40 mm longitudinal tear in the rubber diaphragm

test_cases.query: What were the oil contamination lab findings for turbine bearing B-101 in report INC-2024-089?
test_cases.reference_answer: Laboratory oil analysis of sample LO-89 showed 850 ppm moisture contamination along with ethylene glycol traces, copper-lead babbitt metal flakes in the oil return pocket, and carbonized sludge occluding orifice valve V-204.
ground_truth_passages: Laboratory oil analysis of sample LO-89 indicated 850 ppm moisture contamination and ethylene glycol traces.
Babbitt metal flakes accumulated in the oil return pocket.
Orifice control valve V-204 internal metering port was 80% occluded by carbonized sludge and particulate debris.

test_cases.query: What was the failure mechanism on Bushing B-Phase that caused transformer TR-200 arc flash?
test_cases.reference_answer: Moisture penetrated through a degraded and cracked nitrile gasket on the top bushing capacitance tap cap of Bushing B-Phase. This caused dielectric breakdown of the paper-oil insulation barrier and ignited an internal phase-to-ground arc flash.
ground_truth_passages: Moisture penetration through a degraded capacitance tap gasket on Bushing B-Phase resulted in dielectric breakdown, initiating an intense phase-to-ground internal arc flash.
High-voltage Bushing B-Phase had severe electrical tracking across its lower oil-immersed porcelain skirt.

test_cases.query: What corrective actions were mandated for yard stacker conveyor drive motor M-301?
test_cases.reference_answer: Corrective actions for motor M-301 included dry-ice blast cleaning of motor cooling ribs, replacing drive-end bearing B-301 with Kluberplex BEM 41-132 synthetic polyurea grease, revising PM schedule PM-E-301 to mandate bi-weekly air washdowns, and installing a wireless vibration and surface temperature telemetry pod VM-301.
ground_truth_passages: Performed thorough dry-ice blast cleaning of motor cooling ribs, fan cowl, and intake cowlings.
Replaced drive-end bearing B-301 and flushed housing with high-temperature polyurea synthetic grease (Kluberplex BEM 41-132).
Revised mechanical PM schedule PM-E-301 to mandate bi-weekly pressurized air washdown of exterior motor fins.
Installed wireless continuous tri-axial vibration and surface temperature telemetry pod

test_cases.query: What was the NPSHa versus NPSHr discrepancy that damaged boiler feed pump BFP-02?
test_cases.reference_answer: Net Positive Suction Head available (NPSHa) dropped to 2.1 meters, falling significantly below the pump's required NPSHr of 3.8 meters, inducing severe micro-jet vapor bubble collapse and pitting the 1st stage impeller vanes up to 6 mm depth.
ground_truth_passages: Hydraulic cavitation due to available Net Positive Suction Head (NPSHa) falling to 2.1 meters, well below pump required NPSHr of 3.8 meters.
catastrophic pitting erosion on the suction vane inlets of the 1st stage impeller.
